report.summary: A change in who reviewed is supported. The mix of reviewers with under 2 hours of playtime rose to 3.66% in the window compared to 1.48% in the baseline. The positive share among reviewers with under 2 hours of playtime was 92.31% in the window. Composition changes contributed a fall of 1.0 percentage points to the sentiment change during the window. There were 13 new players who reviewed the game during the window, accounting for a 3.66% share of the reviews. New players accounted for 1.48% of reviews in the baseline period. The patch, a price change or sale, off-topic reviews or a review bomb, and noise or seasonality are inconclusive.
